ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server:2026.1-rc.documentedAt: docs/get-started/quickstart.md §1 — "The server image is the 2026.1 release channel `ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server:2026.1-rc` ... The exact digest for a release is `server.image` in that release's `customer-install-manifest.json`"; §2 writes `HONUA_IMAGE=ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server:2026.1-rc` (honua-io/honua-server#5738). The gate certifies the candidate behind the channel, so the executed block pulls the manifest's image@digest; the published page keeps the channel tag

ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server:rc.documentedAt: docs/get-started/quickstart.md — the server image is the release channel `ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server:rc`, the tag honua-server's release-bundle workflow publishes for the rc channel (.github/workflows/release-bundle.yml, `--tag ${REGISTRY_GHCR}/${IMAGE_NAME}:${channel}`); the gate certifies the candidate behind the channel, so the executed block pulls the manifest's image@digest
